authorization: FLOWER_CELLS_MULTICLASS_2026-09-22: user-declared CDC GenHlth alternative; CTG and HAR561 remain documented measurements; no further alternative.

dataset.name: cdc45k GenHlth
dataset.citation: CDC Diabetes Health Indicators [Dataset]. (2017). UCI Machine Learning Repository.
dataset.target: GenHlth: 1 excellent, 2 very good, 3 good, 4 fair, 5 poor; treated as nominal multiclass
dataset.row_unit: One row per survey respondent, as documented by UCI; row-level privacy is the contract default.
dataset.cohort: Exact logistic n-scaling cdc45k membership: R seed 20260819, sample rounded proportional counts within Diabetes_binary classes, concatenate and sort source row indices, trim only excess beyond 45000. Diabetes_binary is used only to reproduce cohort membership, never as a model feature.
dataset.size_choice: cdc45k fixed at 45000 rows; 20 inputs and linear softmax on provisioned 32-vCPU pod. No timing pilot or scored fallback.

split.type: 80/20 split stratified by GenHlth using rounded per-class test counts, followed by shuffled per-class round-robin dealing into three sites; copied campaign_split algorithm.
split.seed_scope: Cohort partitioning and central initialization; federated initialization and cryptographic sticky node DP randomness retain release behavior.

bounds_policy: Fixed public schema, copied from the CDC trees campaign declaration: binary [0,1], BMI [0,100] (declared clipping domain, not empirical extrema), MentHlth/PhysHlth [0,30], Age [1,13], Education [1,6], Income [1,8]. Clip and affine-scale to [-1,1] identically for central and federation; no empirical test or train bounds.

training.parameters: All v0.5.0 registry optimization defaults: linear softmax, SGD, learning_rate 0.1, batch_size 32, local_epochs 1, momentum 0, nesterov false, weight_decay 0, l1_penalty 0, scheduler none, hidden_layers []; only n_classes=5 supplies the public output schema.
training.privacy: Row unit, clipping norm 1, replace-one adjacency, epsilon per node training. Nine fits do not constitute a single composed privacy guarantee.
training.inner_validation: None; no tuning or model selection.

central: Unregularized multinomial logistic regression nnet::multinom(decay=0,maxit=3000,reltol=1e-10,MaxNWts=10000), identical training rows and public bounded transform. Require convergence=0; fit once per split seed and reuse scores across epsilon.
trivial: Training class proportions for probabilities; their majority for hard prediction. No test prevalence used.
metrics: Mean of five one-vs-rest rank AUCs with average ties, argmax accuracy with first-class tie break, natural-log log-loss with true-class probability floor 1e-15. Paired gap = federated-DP macro-AUC minus central; mean and sample SD over three replicates.
diagnostics: Annotations only, not acceptance or pass/fail: epsilon-8 mean macro-AUC > 0.5 and accuracy strictly above majority predictor test accuracy; disclose replicate indicators too. Report any outcome; no further alternative.
test_use: Preparation reads raw data only to reproduce the fixed cohort and stratified partitions, writes sealed held-out RDS and separate training RDS without examining or reporting test values/statistics. Training opens only training RDS. After all three central and nine federated models finish, create scoring marker and open sealed held-out RDS once in one final scoring phase. Score each fitted model once; reuse central scores across epsilon. Never rerun a scored cell or change settings after scoring.
failure_policy: Refuse existing run directories, score markers and cell artifacts; preserve failures and artifacts. Release code and the shared/logistic/CTG/HAR tooling remain unchanged.
